newsitem.title: LATVIA: Leading Latvian bank Unibanka calls off merger.
newsitem.headline: Leading Latvian bank Unibanka calls off merger.

text.p: Leading Latvian bank Unibanka on Tuesday called off a merger with fellow commercial bank Zemes Banka and the two banks said the synergies which they at first thought were present turned out not to be as big as thought.
Unibanka, the second bank in terms of assets and still partially state-owned, was due to merge with eighth largest bank Zemes Banka.
But in a surprise statement the two banks said they would continue to operate as separate banks.

"After discussions with major shareholders of the two banks and with their full support, it is considered that better shareholder value would be achieved in the medium term if A/S Latvijas Unibanka and A/S Latvijas Zemes Banka were to continue to operate as independent banks," the two banks said in a statement.
"Therefore the merger investigations and discussions will now cease," the bank added.
Analysts had said Unibanka needed to merge to compete in the pan-Baltic market with banks like Estonia's Hansapank HANS.TL which has aggressively expanded outside Estonia.
